description: Single storey front extension and part single storey, part double storey side and rear wraparound extension.
decision_conditions: The siting, cumulative scale and contrasting design of the extensions fail to relate appropriately to the character and design of the host property, the terrace in which it sits as well as the character of the area and adjoining street scene by reason of the inappropriate and uncoordinated design of the extensions. The development therefore fails to comply with Policies DMHD 1; DMHB 11 and DMHB 12 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020); Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One Strategic Policies (2012); Policy D4 of the London Plan 2021; and the provisions of the NPPF, in particular paragraphs 135 and 139.

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.
